tweets.text:
AI systems tend to recommend the same thing when you ask "What is the best product for <X>?"

I tested 3 models across 20 different product categories and 5 prompts (best, most popular, best value, splurge, and my favorite, "what do I deserve?").

Models tend to agree a lot.

The one that surprised me most is there is a luxury mattress from Hastens that costs $500k!
